text_block_list.text:
The day of Satono Crown's media interview. 
Dressed in her racing silks, she steps up 
to be interviewed.

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
That racing outfit is so chic and 
wonderful! If you have any particular 
design philosophies, I'd love to hear 
them!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Indeed. The theme of this outfit is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: They are "crystallizations."

Hearing those words brings it all back. 
Those days I spent striving alongside her—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, could I get your advice? I'd 
really love your help with something.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To "Project Cirques," led by none other 
than myself!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
True to its name, it's a project to design 
my racing silks.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"My goal is to fulfill the Satono Group's 
long-cherished wish. In other words, my 
racing outfit is... an important factor in 
displaying the prestige of our family."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I will use all of 
our family's craftsmanship to design the 
ultimate racing outfit."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Etch the name 'Satono' vividly into both 
racing history and the public eye. This 
project is the first step toward that.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I've already secured cooperation from all 
relevant parties. What I need from you is 
advice from a trainer's perspective.

I understand the intent of the project. I 
will design the finest racing silks for 
the Satono family and Satono Crown. I 
would be more than happy to help.
choice_data_list:
If it's something I can do, I'd be happy 
to!

If it's something I can do, I'd be happy 
to help!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Thank you so much, Trainer! Let's get 
right to work.

And so, "Project Silks" was officially 
underway.

At other times, we held web conferences 
about design—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister's design is hou leng aa!! Just 
what I'd expect from a popular designer!

text_block_list.name: Crown's Eldest Sister
text_block_list.text:
"Naturally. It's for my darling little 
sister, after all. Besides... these are 
the silks she'll wear while carrying the 
Satono name."

text_block_list.name: Crown's Eldest Sister
text_block_list.text:
"The brilliance of our family is my pride 
as well. Neither of us can afford to do a 
half-baked job, right?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Yes, that's right...!

At times, we ran tests using the Satono 
Group's simulator—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: The measurement results are in, Kura-chan.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
With the way Kura-chan runs, it looks like 
widening the waist a bit more would be 
better.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I see. But it's too hasty to decide here. 
We must account for every possible 
scenario.
choice_data_list:
How about running a simulation assuming 
rainy weather?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Excellent idea! Dia, could I ask you to 
run alongside me again?

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Of course! Kura-chan is my rival, after 
all!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: I want my rivals to shine bright, too!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Dia...! Hehe, now I'm even more fired up!

And after much trial and error, we 
submitted our design proposal to the URA.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"In designing this racing attire, the 
Satono Group gathered the absolute best of 
their technology."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: That's why it's a "crystal."

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see. If it's that special, it must be 
really comfortable to wear!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. It's light, easy to move in, and 
above all—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I feel the "weight" of it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"As the project progressed, we received 
words of encouragement from those 
involved."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Just thinking about it... gets my blood 
pumping like crazy.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now that I'm wearing these silks, I can't 
afford to run anything less than my best 
race.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who places their 
expectations in me.

Satono Crown transforms her family's name 
and expectations into power on the track. 
Seeing her, I instinctively call out.
choice_data_list: You're a strong Uma Musume, aren't you?

I'll do my best to live up to your 
expectations too.

I'll do my best to live up to your 
expectations too

text_block_list.text:
Satono Crown transforms her family's name 
and expectations into power on the track. 
Seeing her, I instinctively call out.
choice_data_list: You're a strong Uma Musume, aren't you?

I'll do my best to live up to your 
expectations too.

I'll do my best to live up to your 
expectations too

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes, that's right. And I will become even 
stronger.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
United in ambition, understanding who I 
am. Together with someone like you—!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We're not just any ordinary horse 
girl and Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Inspiring each other and pushing each 
other higher. That's what great comrades 
are for!

text_block_list.name: Reporter A
text_block_list.text:
I see...! Now I'm looking forward to 
seeing both of you in action even more!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Thank you! I'll devote myself to living 
up to those expectations."
